Hartford gate kiosk incident, Aug 3, 2026 (ticket INC-4821)
- First report: 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks offline at the Hartford plant; both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan. Gate check-in affected; scheduling still worked from the dispatch office.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM (per your 11:08 AM update).
- Open item: status-page access for Mateo's login was still being chased at the time of the 11:08 update. Carrowmere Cloud was checking the Hartford gateway route.
